description: This file defines the WsController class, a Web API controller responsible for handling WebSocket connections, accepting requests, managing WebSocket lifecycle, and processing incoming messages.

classes.name: WsController
classes.description: A Web API controller that manages WebSocket connections, allowing clients to connect, receive messages, and handle connection lifecycle events.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to establish WebSocket connections, accepting or rejecting the WebSocket handshake.

methods.name: ReceiveLoop
methods.description: Asynchronous method that manages receiving messages from an open WebSocket, logging activity, and handling connection closure.
